day_shape: 74 items: Khamenei funeral logistics dominate Iranian state channels following his killing, Iran denies direct US talks in Qatar around an Islamabad MoU, IDF announces multiple Gaza strikes killing Hamas/PIJ commanders, IRGC reports deadly northwest clashes, UK pledges £23m to UNRWA.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral preparations and messaging
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-linked channels published extensive logistics, traffic and volunteer notices for the farewell and funeral of the 'martyred Leader' at Tehran's prayer ground, alongside tributes from officials. Iran International reported a confidential security directive instructing media to avoid political disputes and limit coverage of US talks during the funeral period.

threads.label: US-Iran Qatar talks and Islamabad MoU
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman said there are no talks with the US side in Qatar and that Gharibabadi is meeting Qataris on the memorandum of understanding, while Qatar's foreign ministry said Witkoff and Kushner would not hold direct talks with Iranian officials. Iran International reported President Pezeshkian said the MoU was agreed in full coordination with Mojtaba Khamenei; Khamenei's office posted the seven Islamabad MoU conditions.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Yibna Battalion commander Mohammad Fathi Abu Fakher in Rafah, plus Islamic Jihad Nukhba commander Ali Qaid Mohammed Stitan and PIJ cell commander Talal al-Aal, both linked to the October 7 attack. Freed hostage Rom Braslavski thanked the IDF after being told his captor had been killed.

threads.label: Northwest Iran clashes and IRGC future
threads.summary: The IRGC said six armed men were killed near Iran's northwestern border on Tuesday, hours after announcing two Guards killed in a separate shooting; IRIB also published images of a 'terrorist team' dismantled at an Army Ground Forces base. The Jerusalem Post asked whether the clashes mark a Kurdish insurgency, while Iran International examined establishment commentary on potentially restructuring the IRGC.

threads.label: Dana corvette attack response
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi visited a Navy exhibition for the 'Dana' training corvette and called the attack a war crime, saying the Foreign Ministry's legal department will gather evidence in cooperation with the Navy. Government spokesman Mohajerani also visited the memorial and praised the Navy's role in the 'Ramadan War'.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and Israeli defence posture
threads.summary: Netanyahu told soldiers the IDF will remain in the security zone inside Lebanon until Hezbollah no longer poses a threat, and Israel's Defense Ministry announced an Iron Dome upgrade following tests by DDR&D and Rafael. Magos Systems secured a NIS 21 million radar contract expected to be deployed along the Lebanese border against Hezbollah FPV drones.

threads.label: Gaza humanitarian, governance and UK funding
threads.summary: The UK FCDO announced £23 million in further support for UNRWA at a UN pledging conference, while US-led Board of Peace representatives met in Cyprus to prepare a Palestinian technocrat committee for Gaza. Defa Press cited Guterres saying Israeli attacks since the ceasefire have killed more than 1,000 Palestinians, and reported a strike near Khan Yunis.
